description: This is a test script written in shell language for a project that manages Git repositories. It prepares test cases to verify the functionality of pathspec restrictions in Git diff and related commands, including testing wildcards, submodules, and path limits.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function to define a test case expecting success, runs a set of shell commands as the test.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: A helper function to compare the current diff output with an expected output.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables for equality.
